placements.why: This envelope establishes a recurring rehearsal cadence, a rationale for why rehearsal is what makes a capability real, and a named owner — none of that is Opportunity, Strategy, Product, Proof, Templates, or Calibration territory, and nothing in the (currently empty) strata tier covers organizational readiness practice. The content calls for a home for this and future readiness/resilience material, so it is minted standalone with no forced parent.
placements.title: operational resilience becomes its own organizational category
placements.frame: What practices exist to verify that a claimed operational capability is actually real, tested, and owned rather than assumed?

placements.title: rehearsal is what makes a capability real, not merely claimed
placements.frame: Is a capability being treated as genuinely possessed only once it has been actively rehearsed, rather than assumed to exist from design, documentation, or intent?
placements.why: The four segments together carry one recurring subject future envelopes will keep feeding: the directive establishing monthly cadence (src-1), the aphoristic principle that an unrehearsed rollback is not actually a rollback (src-2), the formalized cadence spec (src-3), and the named owner accountable for it (src-4) are all expressions of the same theme — that operational capability is only real when it is regularly exercised and someone is accountable for exercising it. No existing leaf exists to reuse (the graph is empty for this repo), and this is a subject, not a one-time fact — later drills, results, or cadence revisions would continue to support it, satisfying the narrative grain test rather than the fact-grain one.
